captions.detailed: This 3D printable model features a multi-part customizable pen set consisting of a hexagonal pen body, a matching hexagonal cap, and a small plug. The main pen body has a long hexagonal profile with a tapered, conical writing tip at one end and flat triangular 'ears' at both ends to assist with bed adhesion. The hollow cap is also hexagonal, designed to slide over the ends of the pen body, while the small plug fits into the rear opening to secure the ink cartridge.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric pen body, cap, and plug set in OpenSCAD compatible with a standard ink cartridge like the Pilot G2. The script should allow customization of the outer hexagonal profile shape, body length, wall thickness, and include optional flat triangular ears at the ends to prevent warping during 3D printing.
captions.factory: The model is built using a combination of cylinder and cube primitives arranged with translate and rotate operations. The main pen body is created as a long cylinder with a low fragment count ($fn=6) to produce a hexagonal prism, combined with a tapered cone at the tip using another cylinder with differing start and end radii. Triangular anti-warp ears are added using thin flat polygons or cylinders, and a separate hollow cap is formed by subtracting an inner hexagonal cylinder from an outer one.
